records.research_economic_bridge: average interest-earning assets × margin + fee/wealth/markets revenue − expected credit loss − expense − tax, translated through FX and capital distributions

records.derating_falsifiers: China/HK property or commercial-real-estate losses; deposit and wealth competition; falling rates without asset repricing relief; regulatory/geopolitical friction; FX translation

records.limitations: Group-wide averages hide Hong Kong, UK ring-fenced, mainland China, Mexico and global-markets differences; reported and adjusted RoTE are not interchangeable.

records.business_scope: UK domestic retail/commercial bank; mortgage and unsecured lender; insurer/wealth adjacency
